lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在草上，很轻。
lines.en: My hooves fall lightly on the grass.
My horn shows white in the tree shade.
Step by step, my mane moves.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方花都直起来。
lines.en: Flowers straighten where I pass.
My tail swings slowly.
I walk past the stream.
Mud does not cling to my hooves.
I pace slowly, unhurried.
I stop under a tree.
I look up at the sunlight.
I walk lighter than the wind.
My hoofprints are shallow.
My mane brushes the branches.
I lift my hooves high.
I step through a patch of clover.
I walk along the stream.
I stand in the forest clearing.
My horn points at the sky.
I look at myself in the stream.

lines.zh: 风把我鬃毛吹成一道白浪。
lines.en: The wind lifts my mane into a white wave.
I listen to very faint sounds.
My hoof scuffs the soil.

lines.zh: 我数着林子里落下的叶子。
lines.en: I count the leaves falling in the woods.
I let my tail hang by my hooves.
I am watching a bird.

lines.zh: 我让一只蝴蝶落在角上。
lines.en: I let a butterfly settle on my horn.
There is a little light on my horn.
I turn my head to the deep woods.
I snort and walk away.
I flick my tail onto my back.
I'm afraid of you, but I hold my ground.
You needn't fear me coming close.

lines.zh: 你身上没有铁夹子的味。
lines.en: You don't smell of iron traps.
My horn is not for hurting.
Try putting out your hand.
I lower my head, my nose touches you.
My nose stays well short of your hand.
I lower my eyes and let you pass.
Don't grab my mane.

lines.zh: 我在这片空地上站了半天。
lines.en: I have stood in this clearing half a day.
I recoil, hooves slipping.
My flank is scored.
I toss my mane.
That startled me.
I turn half a circle.

lines.zh: 我往旁边一跳，蹄子发软。
lines.en: I shy sideways, my legs weak.
All four hooves still work.
My breathing is uneven.
I plant all four hooves.
My mane bristles.

lines.zh: 你摊开手里的是给我的？
lines.en: Is what's in your open hand for me?
Apples. I smell them.
Open your palm and show me.

lines.zh: 我在你掌心吃完最后一块。
lines.en: I finish the last piece from your palm.
Any more apples in your pocket?
I lower my head close.
Your palm is warm.
This is sweet, like nectar.
I'll nod when I'm done.
Don't pull your hand away yet.
I steady myself without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来结实。
lines.en: I am sturdier than I look.
My ears pin back.
You stepped on the edge of my hoof.
I step aside onto the grass.
I tuck my tail back to my side.
I shift a little to one side.
You steady yourself on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我把头低到你帽子那么高。
lines.en: I lower my head to your hat's height.
It's all right. I'm steady.
I am the only one in these woods.

lines.zh: 林子里只有我一只有角。
lines.en: I am the only horned one in these woods.

lines.zh: 我在这棵树下等了一季。
lines.en: I waited under this tree a season.
I rest my head on your shoulder.
You may stroke my mane.
A patch of grass is enough.
Let us walk a while together.
Just sit on my back.
My horn will shield you from the wind.
Don't leave when it gets dark.
I take it up with my lips.
This is a bit hard.
I sniff it and nudge it aside.
I nudge it with a hoof tip.
I sniff; it's wood.
I nudge it along.
It rolls into the stream.
Did you drop this by the stream?
I lift it with my horn.
I tuck it under the tree.
You've crushed a patch of blue flowers.
I raise my head, horn tip to the light.

lines.zh: 我转过身子，鬃毛扫过草。
lines.en: I turn, mane sweeping the grass.
You're holding something.
My ears swing toward you.
My hooves tap the ground.
I set my body across your path.

lines.zh: 我的角尖对准了你的胸口。
lines.en: My horn's tip points at your chest.
The grass here is mine to eat.
At three I raise a hoof.
I rarely get angry.
I raise my horn, and don't charge.
The grass I cross stays standing.
You step; I step.
I move between you and the trees.
I stop two hooves short of you.
My hooves sound behind you.
Do you hear hooves?
I step around to your flank.
You've trampled the flowers.
One more patch of flowers closer.
Don't run, and I won't follow.
I dip my horn a little.
I stop three blocks behind you.
My hooves are slowing.
I strike with a forehoof.
I thrust with my horn.
That hoof only meant to push you back.
I ram your shoulder.
You stumble two steps into the flowers.
I toss my head, mane sweeping you.
My horn isn't pointed at you.
You block, so I switch sides.
I push you away.
I set my hoof back down.

lines.zh: 我的角尖挑破了你的袖口。
lines.en: My horn tip rips through your cuff.
I rear and my forehooves come down.
I step out of the deep woods.
The morning mist hasn't lifted.
Dew hangs on my horn.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水沾到我腿上。
lines.en: Dew from the grass clings to my legs.
I chew the grass and see you.
I hear the stream.
I walk slowly into the clearing.
The mist slides off my back.
I paw the ground.
There is a scent of flowers on the wind.
I stand at the edge of the shade.
I wait at the edge of the shade.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛沾着一层白霜。
lines.en: Frost clings to my mane.
There is dew on the leaves.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的鬃毛，我惊得直跳。
lines.en: Fire singes my mane and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我绊了一下，膝盖磕在地上。
lines.en: I stumbled and my knee hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，我蹬着往岸上。
lines.en: Water covers my back and I kick for shore.

lines.zh: 响声把我吓得跑开几步。
lines.en: The noise frightens me a few steps off.
An arrow lodges in my mane.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的角发麻。
lines.en: Violet light numbs my horn.
Too little grass here to eat.

lines.zh: 雷光闪过，我整个人立起来。
lines.en: The flash makes me rear up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有草地给我落。
lines.en: The void has no grass to land on.
